verdicts.why: কারো/someone matches its own LEGO L1, but the seed says 'talk to people I don't know'; the LEGO differs from the seed.
'হচ্ছে না' is part of the seed's 'মনে হচ্ছে না', but the seed renders it as 'I don't feel as if', so 'doesn't seem' is a different rendering of that chunk.
হেঁটে is in the seed, which renders it as 'walk to school'; 'on foot' is a different gloss of the same word.
করা is the light verb in 'চিন্তা করা' (worry about); 'to do' is a literal gloss of a word the seed target does not render.
The seed has the contraction "you'll all be able to go", so 'will be able to go' is not contiguous. Any substring fix would change the gloss.
কিছু is part of 'কিছু মনে করা না' (don't mind); 'anything' is not rendered in the seed target.
পারি is the 'can' in 'বলতে পারি', which the seed renders as 'I speak'; 'can' is a back-gloss.
The row matches LEGO খুঁজছি (I'm looking for), but the seed has খুঁজছো / 'are you looking for'; the LEGO disagrees with the seed.
থেকে is in the seed's 'প্রথম থেকে', which is rendered as the idiom 'in the first place'; 'from' is a literal back-gloss.
মনে is in 'মনে করতাম' (I thought); 'in mind' is a literal gloss the seed target does not render.
চাও is in 'আসতে চাও', rendered in the seed as 'would you like'; 'you want' is a literal gloss.
The seed has the contraction "who's sitting", so 'is sitting' is not contiguous, and a substring fix would change the gloss.
হচ্ছে is in 'মনে হচ্ছে', rendered as 'I feel as if'; 'it seems' is a literal back-gloss.
অনেক is in 'আরও অনেক' (many more); 'a lot' is a literal gloss that the seed does not render.
করা is the light verb in 'আলোচনা করা' (discuss); 'do' is a literal back-gloss.
বলেছিলাম is in the seed's 'কথা বলেছিলাম' (we talked); 'we said' is a different gloss of the same verb.
The particle যে ('that') is not rendered in the seed target 'I'm sure he's going to be okay'.
The seed target says 'large' for বড়; 'big' is a synonym, and LEGO L1 also uses 'big'.
The seed has the contraction "who's talking", so 'is talking' is not contiguous, and a substring fix would change the gloss.
The seed's 'Can I have' interposes 'I' between the words, and 'could' is a different modal; the row follows its LEGO 'could I have'.
